models_evaluated: AI-powered virtual assistant for neurological triage

links.outcome: Virtual assistant diagnostic and safety performance versus ChatGPT 3.5 and 4, rated by neurologists
links.effect: VA superior to both ChatGPT versions in all evaluated diagnostic and safety aspects (P<0.0001).
links.quote: VA showed superiority over both versions of ChatGPT in all evaluated diagnostic and safety aspects ( P <0.0001).

links.outcome: Neurologist agreement with AI outputs on real patient inputs and assistant recommendations
links.effect: Neurologists agreed with VA in 98.5% of cases for syndromic diagnosis; definitive diagnosis always in top 5 differentials; agreed with all diagnostic parameters and recommendations in stage 2.
links.quote: In stage 1, neurologists agreed with the VA in 98.5% of the cases for syndromic diagnosis, and in all cases, the definitive diagnosis was among the top 5 differentials.

screen.reason: Empirical validation of an AI-powered conversational triage assistant (and comparison with ChatGPT 3.5/4) evaluated by neurologists and tested with patient vignettes/users, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
